title: Volleyball Duel
tagline: Jump into a fast volleyball rally.
description: Play a friend on the same device or take on the computer, and learn the controls as you aim to keep the ball in play.
bestFor: timing, positioning, and quick arcade matches.
controls: desktop or mobile browser, with on-screen touch controls on phones.
glance: keyboard on a computer, on-screen buttons on a phone.
short: A cartoon-style volleyball game for two players on one device, or one player against the computer.
about: A cartoon-style volleyball game. Play a friend on the same device or take on the computer, with keyboard controls on a computer and on-screen buttons on a phone. First to ten points wins the match.
